> 26\. > 27. Follow-up: I built the `native-hardware-raytracing` branch ([95ba8da](https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5/commit/95ba8da4bc37a37af198f867b0137e5e35073b7b)) and tested it on the same RX 9070 XT (Adrenalin 32.0.32015.2008). `NativeRayTracing: enabled` is logged and Performance RT runs without errors or visual issues that I could see. Three minutes in the city: **~14 → ~19 fps average** (median 17, range 10–34), host GPU 3D engine ~65 % → ~72 % (up to 90 %). So the host ray query path works on AMD/RDNA4 too. Fidelity not tested yet.
>      
>      
>      Thanks for testing the native raytracing, that part is still quite experimental and has some gliches/issues on shadows, cars and other stuff, i will try to improve the performance when i get a bit of time since at the moment i need to reduce the number of draws done in the Game in some way since CPU threads are already working alot most of the time
